entities.summary: Michael Patrick Mohamed is an American former professional football player who was a linebacker in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the Denver Broncos in the sixth round of the 2011 NFL draft. He played college football for the California Golden Bears. Mohamed is the first player of Punjabi descent in NFL history.
